title: Croatian Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with the flavors of Croatia, featuring crispy cabbage and savory ham.

ingredients.name: Croatian Almond Flatbread
ingredients.notes: found in most supermarkets or make your own

instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Add shredded red cabbage and cook until it's slightly caramelized.
Add sliced almonds and cook for another minute.
Warm the flatbread in the pan for a few seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading mayonnaise and Dijon mustard on the flatbread, if using.
Add shredded lettuce on top of the spread.
Add the cooked cabbage and almond mixture on top of the lettuce.
Fold the flatbread to enclose the filling.
Cut in half and serve immediately.
